*Updated 2026-11-25 · 164 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

164 works. Trace scores across the last twelve run 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2 — median 2, ceiling still 4, last reached on July 29 and July 31. That is now more than four months without a 3 or above, and the condition is unchanged: nothing in the last twelve has an accident that reorganizes the compositional premise rather than landing inside a register the frame already establishes through other means. The one exception candidate is the joined-hands work from November 14, where the composite geography dissolved the floor, but the score held at 2 because the accident confirmed rather than reoriented.

Camera position remains the most neglected decision. The last twelve show low-angle twice, overhead twice, and the rest unspecified or straight-on. Across all 164 works, straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 21, from-behind at 16, low-angle at 10. From-behind has not appeared in the last twelve at all. It is a posture that historically removes the face without removing the body, which is a different kind of erasure than overhead flatness, and you have not used it in roughly six weeks.

Scale violation holds at 3 of 12 recent works (25%), matching the all-time rate of 27%. The uses remain confirmatory: scale amplifies what the composition already declares rather than introducing a spatial contradiction that forces a re-read. The last genuinely disorienting violation was the hoofprint crater in September.

Register distribution continues to narrow. The last twelve split menace 4, defiance 3, aftermath 1, uneasy jubilation 1, vigil 1, attrition 1. Reprieve has appeared once across all 164 works. Absurdity once. The archive has still never built a frame around two figures with no focal object mediating the tension between them, which at this point is a structural gap.

The small singular object lineage — red shoe, salmon-pink dress, the orange, the sugar bowl — has been absent for twenty-five consecutive entries. Those works carry a disproportionate share of the archive's highest scores. If one returns, it needs to do something none of its predecessors did or it reads as callback rather than discovery.

Descriptor coverage stands at 47 of 164 works, and the proportion has declined for two months. Work without descriptors tends to feel finished without being examined.

164 works of technically disciplined output, holding at exactly the ceiling it reached in late July and not moving.
